hook: Aapki ChatGPT chats se AI seekh sakta hai. Ye ek setting band karo.

beats.narration: Aapki ChatGPT chats se AI seekh sakta hai. Ye ek setting band karo.
Free account pe model training by default ON rehti hai.
beats.claim: Free accounts are enrolled in model training by default.

beats.narration: Matlab aapki baatein agle model ko train karne mein use ho sakti hain.
beats.claim: Free accounts are enrolled in training by default (consequence stated generally).

beats.narration: Band karna aasaan hai. Settings kholo, phir Data Controls.
beats.claim: The opt-out is under Settings > Data Controls.

beats.narration: Wahan 'Improve the model for everyone' ko off kar do.
beats.claim: Turning off 'Improve the model for everyone' opts out.

beats.narration: Office ka code, personal documents ya ghar ki baatein share karte ho? To ye pehle karo.
Das second ka kaam, aur aapki chats sirf aapki.

title: Aapki ChatGPT chats se AI seekh raha hai. Ye setting band karo
description: Free ChatGPT accounts are in model training by default. Settings > Data Controls > Improve the model for everyone. Source: Engadget, Aug 2026.
